invariants.rationale: The final result is collected using Collectors.toList(), which never returns null.
The code filters out nulls in the pipeline, so all elements in result are non-null.
Each unique key in 'data' will produce at most one entry in result, meaning result cannot have more elements than data.
Parallelism is used for .parallel(), which should be a positive integer.
Method assumes data is not null since stream operations are invoked on it.
